summary.text: Ryan Bourriaque is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 47 (Calcasieu, Cameron and Vermilion parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page. Ryan Bourriaque chairs the Transportation, Highways and Public Works Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Ryan Bourriaque's occupation as Matilda Stream Management Company.

It lists education as Bachelor's Degree, Psychology, Louisiana State University; Master's in Agricultural Economics with a concentration in Natural Resource Economics and Environmental Policy, Louisiana State University.

The page lists committee assignments including Transportation, Highways and Public Works (chair), the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay and the House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
